# `data/raw/` — capture INDEX

**Generated by `analysis/make_index.py` — do not hand-edit.** Re-run it after every capture. `README.md` in this folder documents the capture *format*; this file says *which folder to read*.

## Campaigns

One campaign = one **wire + protocol**. Cold length is the axis that matters most — it is the same Dynalloy stock throughout — so it is in every folder name. `registered` means the folder is listed in `CAMPAIGNS` in `analysis/analyze_raw.py` and therefore reaches the merged table; an unregistered folder is on disk but in no table.
